<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<AutomationScript version="1">
    <Step type="ClearProject" active="true">

    <Step type="LoadReference" active="true">
        <Note>reference: CBBE 3BBB Body</Note>
        <SourceFile>SliderSets/CBBE 3BBB Body.osp</SourceFile>
        <Set>CBBE 3BBB Body</Set>
        <Shape>CBBE-3BBB</Shape>
        <LoadAll>false</LoadAll>
        <MergeSliders>true</MergeSliders>
        <MergeZaps>true</MergeZaps>
        <AppendNewSliders>false</AppendNewSliders>
    </Step>
    <Step type="AddProject" active="true">
        <Note>the original outfit project (a staged copy; the source is never opened for writing)</Note>
        <SourceFile>SliderSets/MM69 Raider Punk Top - CBBE.osp</SourceFile>
        <Set>MM69 Raider Punk Top - CBBE</Set>
        <AppendNewSliders>true</AppendNewSliders>
    </Step>
    <Step type="DeleteSlider" active="true">
        <Note>remove sliders that only the reference body has (keep the original slider list)</Note>
        <SliderName>ButtCrack, CalfSize, CalfSmooth, CrotchBack, Groin, KneeHeight, LegShape, LegsThin, RoundAss, Thighs, Ankles, MuscularLegs, FeetFeminine</SliderName>
        <Regex>false</Regex>
    </Step>
    <Step type="CopyBoneWeights" active="true">
        <Note>copy bone weights from the reference (full mode)</Note>
        <TargetMeshes>Model001_25_upper_1_0_0</TargetMeshes>
        <TargetRegex>false</TargetRegex>
        <ProximityRadius>5.000000</ProximityRadius>
        <MaxResults>4</MaxResults>
    </Step>
    <Step type="SaveProject" active="true">
        <Note>save a NEW project; AutoCopyRef=false keeps the reference body out of the output</Note>
        <DisplayName>MM69 Raider Punk Top - CBBE - 3BBB AUTO</DisplayName>
        <SliderSetFile>SliderSets/MM69 Raider Punk Top - CBBE - 3BBB AUTO.osp</SliderSetFile>
        <ShapeDataFolder>MM69 Raider Punk Top - CBBE - 3BBB AUTO</ShapeDataFolder>

        <OutputDataPath>meshes\MM69 Raider Punk</OutputDataPath>
        <OutputFileName>raiderPunk_top</OutputFileName>
        <GenWeights>false</GenWeights>
        <AutoCopyRef>false</AutoCopyRef>
        <CopyRefFromProject>false</CopyRefFromProject>
    </Step>
</AutomationScript>
